summary: Frontend-only review of the Thrillophilia Kazakhstan (14) + Bhutan (34) import. Tested both listing pages, 14/14 Kazakhstan detail pages and 13/34 Bhutan detail pages (including the shortest and the longest), plus filters, sort, Venice regression and China/Vietnam/Japan regression pages. Everything passes - 100% success. Listings show the correct counts, infinite-scroll loads all 14 and all 34 cards with unique lead images, old generic packages are gone, every detail page renders H1 + a correct number of Day tabs + the included-stats tile + no broken images and no 4xx on CDN assets. Filter chips (incl. all the required Theme + Experience chips) return non-empty filtered sets and clear restores the full count. The 'Venice canals & gondolas' chip no longer appears on Kazakhstan. Regression pages still load.

issues: There is no explicit 'What's not included' / 'Exclusions' section on any detail page. The sidebar only shows the included-stats tile (hotels/experiences/transfers/meals). This is NOT a regression - it is the same on the China/Vietnam/Japan trips that were previously marked 100% pass - but the review-request wording ('the included and not-included sections render') implies one should exist. Flagging as a design gap for the main agent to decide.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/frontend/src/tours/*Data.js files are growing fast (48 new) - fine as data, but consider lazy-importing them in the trip registry so the main JS bundle does not keep ballooning.
No 'not-included' / exclusions component exists in /app/frontend/src/components - if that section is intended, it is missing globally, not just on the new imports.
